label: TP
reason: User input from the query string is extracted and URL-decoded. The conditional guard (7*42)-106 > 200 evaluates to false deterministically, forcing the assignment of the user input to 'bar'. This value is concatenated directly into the SQL query string without sanitization, enabling SQL Injection. The XSS alert is also triggered on this path due to the unsanitized string concatenation.
